subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` flag that lets `--check` ignore lower-severity findings when operators opt in?
rationale: The implementation is clean and default-compatible, but deciding whether info-level secrets-audit findings may be non-blocking in automation is a security-audit policy choice for the secops-owned secrets surface.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now and invite a secrets/security owner to reopen or sponsor the threshold if the policy is accepted.

options.title: Sponsor current flag
options.body: Accept the new public CLI contract because the default remains `info` and the PR includes focused tests, docs, and terminal proof.

options.title: Request narrower policy
options.body: Ask for a narrower owner-approved gate, such as limiting threshold behavior to specific finding classes or folding it into a broader audit policy design.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now and invite a secrets/security owner to reopen or sponsor the threshold if the policy is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest feature-history connection to the secrets audit CLI and can route the policy question to secops owners if needed.
